caseName: W. R. Arthur & Co. v. Wisconsin Department of Taxation
caseNameFull: W. R. ARTHUR & CO., INC. v. WISCONSIN DEPARTMENT OF TAXATION
attorneys: Adolph J. Bieberstein, John C. Wickhem and George L. Weisbard for appellant., George Thompson, Attorney General of Wisconsin, and Harold H. Persons and E. Weston Wood, Assistant Attorneys General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
